title: Nineteen platforms in one PHP package
text: 19 platforms, 21 driver keys, optional dependencies, and one API across six frameworks. One PHP API for big data A Composer package for 19 big data platforms: SQL and OLAP, Hadoop, lakehouse metadata, schedulers, and NoSQL, with optional dependencies.

title: One package, nineteen platforms
text: bigdata-php connects to SQL and OLAP engines, the Hadoop ecosystem, schedulers, lakehouse metadata catalogs, and NoSQL stores through one PHP API. HTTP drivers work out of the box; optional dependencies for Doris, StarRocks, Hive, and Cassandra are checked only when that driver is created. One entry point, isolated drivers Optional dependencies on demand Six frameworks share one Manager

title: One entry point, many drivers
text: Drivers are created on demand and cached by name, with no unified SQL layer.

title: Unified driver management
text: BigData::driver creates and caches instances by name; unknown keys are rejected.

title: Optional dependencies
text: pdo_mysql, thrift, and php-cassandra are checked only when their driver is created.

title: SQL and OLAP
text: Trino, Doris, StarRocks, Kylin, and Druid share one result convention.

title: Hadoop and lakehouse
text: WebHDFS, YARN, Hive, Spark, Flink, plus read-only lakehouse metadata.

title: Scheduling and NoSQL
text: Airflow, DolphinScheduler, Oozie, HBase, and Cassandra.

title: Six framework adapters
text: Laravel, ThinkPHP, Webman, Hyperf, Yii2, and Yii3.
